name: thread
title: Thread
description: One line draws itself down the page as you scroll, linking sections like a seam, a route or a timeline.

meta.reducedMotion: The line is fully drawn and still.
meta.useWhen: Journeys, timelines, craft (stitching, drawing), routes and process pages.
meta.avoidWhen: As decoration on a page without a journey; together with another scroll signature.
